text_block_list.name: Mother with Baby
text_block_list.text: Omigosh! It's Kitasan Black! U-u-um, I'm a huge fan of yours!

text_block_list.name: Mother with Baby
text_block_list.text: Erm, if it's not too much trouble… Do you think you could sing a measure or two of a song for me? I just love how your voice sounds!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Haha, no problem! Here I go!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Oh no! I didn't mean to sing that loudly! I-I'm sorry!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Kitasan Black tries desperately to soothe the baby, all the while feeling terrible for making them cry.
